context:
Goal: each repo's map of its code stays true, with one tool for it.
Problem (rule): banchi keeps its own map and drift check (docs-audit map family), beside the shared plain-english-map skill, so the same job has two homes.
Based on (read): plan, banchi row 42: STAYS ?, no incident, banchi docs/map.py against cs plain-english-map.
Based on (read): CLAUDE.md rule building-one-home-per-capability: a duplicate needs a stated reason.
Departs from: banchi's own map check — banchi moves to the shared skill.

options.gain: One map tool in every repo.
options.how: A banchi lane adopts plain-english-map, then deletes docs/map.py and its checks.
options.label: Move banchi to the shared skill

options.how: banchi records why its map differs.
options.label: Keep banchi's map
